{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are too low during price rallies - needs 3-5% upward bias when sentiment is positive",
    "Forecast lag: model misses rapid price turns by 1-2 days, needs lead-in adjustment",
    "Mean-reversion bias too strong - model bottoms too early when prices are in uptrends",
    "Sentiment alignment: model under-forecasts when sentiment is strongly bullish (0.8+)",
    "Volatility adaptation missing - model uses constant confidence but true volatility varies 2-3x",
    "When price has been flat, model over-confident - needs uncertainty band expansion",
    "Sentiment momentum: model ignores sentiment acceleration/deceleration signals"
] }
